US Open Quarterfinal: Shelton Faces Defending Champion Alcaraz

American Ben Shelton, seeded eighth, is set to compete against the defending champion Carlos Alcaraz, seeded second, in a US Open quarterfinal match. The match is scheduled to take place at Arthur Ashe Stadium. Live updates and coverage are being provided for the event, including previews and start times.
